title: English Practice Quiz 0981
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Before giving a presentation, it is wise to ___.
questions.explanation: Checking equipment helps prevent avoidable interruptions.

questions.question: A speaker who talks too quickly should ___.
questions.explanation: A slower pace and pauses make ideas easier to follow.

questions.question: Which phrase is best for introducing the main topic?
options: Let us begin by looking at the main issue.
questions.explanation: This phrase clearly signals the start of the topic.

questions.question: A visual aid should mainly ___.
questions.explanation: Visual aids should reinforce, not replace, the explanation.

questions.question: At the end of a presentation, a speaker should ___.
questions.explanation: A short summary helps the audience remember the message.

questions.question: If an audience member asks a difficult question, you should ___.
questions.explanation: Listening first helps you understand the question accurately.

questions.question: The phrase 'to illustrate a point' means to ___.
questions.explanation: An illustration is an example that makes an idea clearer.

questions.question: Which transition introduces a contrast?
questions.explanation: However introduces an opposing or contrasting idea.

questions.question: A presentation outline helps a speaker ___.
questions.explanation: An outline gives the talk a clear structure.

questions.question: When using a microphone, you should generally ___.
questions.explanation: A steady, suitable distance keeps the sound clear.
